The Honda Fit family

4 generations and variants in the Index, 2007–2020. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 2007–2008

    Honda Fit (first generation)

    The first Fit sold in America, 2007–2008: a small hatchback from Japan with a 109-hp engine and the folding Magic Seat.

    109 hp8.7 sec 0-60164,322 built
    5-speed manual · 5-speed automatic
  2. 2009–2013

    Honda Fit (second generation)

    The second Fit, 2009–2013: longer and wider, with 117 hp, built in Japan and later in China too.

    117 hp8.5 sec 0-60283,763 built
    5-speed manual · 5-speed automatic
  3. 2013–2014

    Honda Fit EV

    Honda's electric Fit, 2013–2014: lease only, about 1,100 built, with an 82-mile range and the EPA's best efficiency rating of its time.

    123 hp8.5 sec 0-601,069 built
  4. 2015–2020

    Honda Fit (third generation)

    The last Fit sold in America, 2015–2020: built in Mexico, with a 130-hp direct-injected engine, a CVT option and, from 2018, Honda Sensing.

    130 hp8.2 sec 0-60327,968 built
    6-speed manual · CVT
